'''Li Jiangang''' ({{zh|s=李建刚}}; born 3 November 1961) is a Chinese [[plasma physicist]]. He is a [[research fellow]] at the [[Hefei Institutes of Physical Science]] and a professor of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] (USTC). He formerly served as Vice President of USTC and Director of the [[Institute of Plasma Physics]], [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0" /> He was elected an [[academician]] of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] in 2015.<ref name=":0" />

Li was born in [[Hefei]], [[Anhui]], China. He graduated from [[Harbin Engineering University]] in 1982.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/colys/57959283.html|title=中国工程院|website=www.cae.cn|access-date=2019-02-03}}</ref> He earned his master's degree in 1985 and Ph.D. in 1990, from the [[Institute of Plasma Physics]], [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://people.ucas.edu.cn/~0005180|title=个人主页|website=people.ucas.edu.cn|access-date=2019-02-03}}</ref> He is an editor of peer-reviewed journals including ''[[Plasma Science and Technology]]'' and ''[[Nuclear Fusion (journal)|Nuclear Fusion]].''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.snst.ustc.edu.cn/2012/0924/c3956a32870/page.htm|title=李建刚|website=www.snst.ustc.edu.cn|access-date=2019-02-03}}</ref>
